items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: And in that band I remember Hershel Evans... And a trumpet player by the name of Red Mack, and Gladys was in charge of the band.

ctx.x: The Spike Bro -- no, I didn't see the Spike Brothers. I -- they, they weren't -- I don't believe they were -- I can't recall -- now maybe they were still there -- they were there, but I never got a chance to see them. Anyway, that a -- in Los Angeles the jazz, the jazz business was pretty, pretty good, and we -- I made a nice little living with the Max Melody Makers band, and pretty soon I, I worked in the -- with the Irving Brothers in, in the, the Palomino Dance Hall. And it was ten cents a dance then. At that…
Mack, and Gladys was in charge of the band. I remember you couldn't whees, whistle in Lionel's dressing room. So . . .
